about_the_game:
A ten-track concept album from the galaxy’s least reliable employees – One More Game.

Rare & Questionable Cuts is SWAPMEAT’s musical companion piece — a collection of ridiculous anthems written with a skewed perspective from within the world of SWAPMEAT. Each song loosely parodies a corner of the universe: corporate zealots, interstellar unions, rogue cults, and the one thing that brings them together — they all smash beers.

Inspired by the unhinged tone of I Think You Should Leave, Rick & Morty, and the immersive weirdness of Meow Wolf, these tracks twist the game’s story into something between a propaganda reel and a sing-along in the bottom of a pirate ship. They’re part of SWAPMEAT’s world — you’ll hear them leaking from terminals, jukeboxes, and the ROX-1 meat lab itself.
